method: Read-only profiling of merged catalog records. Four required fields must contain nonempty material; citation statuses and authority roles are descriptive metadata and do not validate claims.
limitations: Profile completeness measures editorial depth, not evidential support, scientific merit, coverage exhaustiveness, or verification. Triage priority ranks missing editorial work and source-metadata follow-up; it does not rank theories or patients.
triage_formula: 10 * missing_required_fields + 3 * min(pending_metadata_citations, 3) + (2 if no primary-authority citation else 0) + (1 if citation_count <= 2 else 0)
